title: REQ · GameLayout exposes an optional header slot
summary: GameLayout accepts a header ReactNode and renders it over the scene area.
description: Context: GameLayout takes only scene and story. Desired behavior: an optional header prop is rendered inside the relative main element before the scene so HeaderOverlay's absolute positioning anchors to the game area. Expected result: header content appears in main; omitting it changes nothing. Why: App needs to place the header without custom markup.
acceptance_criteria: Given a header node is passed, when GameLayout renders, then the node is inside the main element together with the scene.
Given no header prop, when GameLayout renders, then the layout renders as before with the scene and Story toggle.

preserve: 80/20 grid, drawer toggle and overflow classes
